sn35.99:1.4: cakkhu → cakkhuṁ (bj, sya-all) | cakkhu aniccanti yathābhūtaṁ → cakkhum aniccan ti yathābhūtam (pts)
sn35.99:1.8: pajānāti → pajānāti sotaṁ aniccanti (bj) | tampi aniccanti yathābhūtaṁ → tam pi aniccaṁ yathābhūtam (pts)
sn35.99:1.9: aniccanti → aniccoti (sya-all) | aniccanti yathābhūtaṁ → anicco ti yathābhūtam (pts) | aniccoti → aniccanti (bj: machasaṁ)
sn35.99:1.15: pajānātīti chaṭṭhaṁ → pajānātī ti (bj) | yathābhūtaṁ pajānātīti chaṭṭhaṁ → yathābhūtam pajānātī ti paṭisallāṇam (pts)
